cues.en: Welcome to PyTorch.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到 PyTorch，

cues.en: It's an exciting day.
cues.zh: 今天令人興奮。

cues.en: Today is the official release of PyTorch 2.0, with the main improvement being speed.
cues.zh: 今天是 PyTorch 2.0 正式發布的日子，主要改進就是速度。

cues.en: This comes via a single backward compatible line.
cues.zh: 只需一行向下相容的程式，

cues.en: Torch Compile.
cues.zh: torch.compile。

cues.en: In other words, after you create your model, you can pass it to torch compile to receive a compiled
cues.zh: 換句話說，建立模型後，把模型傳給 torch.compile，取得編譯後的

cues.en: model and in turn expect speed ups in training and inference on newer GPUs.
cues.zh: 模型，進而可期待在較新的 GPU 上，加快訓練與推論。

cues.en: But this is just words.
cues.zh: 但這只是文字說明。

cues.en: How much faster is it, actually?
cues.zh: 實際到底快多少？

cues.en: Well, the PyTorch team ran a test across 163 open source models from Huggingface Transformers Tim or
cues.zh: PyTorch 團隊測試了 163 個開源模型，來自 Hugging Face Transformers、timm，也就是

cues.en: torch image models and Torch Bench, a curated set of popular code bases from across GitHub using a
cues.zh: PyTorch Image Models，以及 TorchBench，後者整理了 GitHub 上許多熱門程式碼專案。他們混合使用

cues.en: mixture of AMP, automatic mixed precision or Float16 training and Float32 precision training, The
cues.zh: AMP，也就是自動混合精度，或 float16 訓練，以及 float32 精度訓練。

cues.en: PyTorch team found that torch dot compile provides an average speed up of 43% in training on an Nvidia a100 GPU.
cues.zh: 團隊發現，在 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上，torch.compile 讓訓練平均加速 43%。

cues.en: That is incredible.
cues.zh: 很驚人。

cues.en: And naturally I tried torch dot compile in one of my own benchmarks.
cues.zh: 我自然也在自己的一個基準測試中試了 torch.compile。

cues.en: I found that it definitely seems that torch dot compile is much better when you're using as much of the GPU as possible, e.g. larger batch sizes and data sizes.
cues.zh: 我發現，盡可能充分利用 GPU 時，例如使用較大的批次與資料量，torch.compile 的效果確實比較好。

cues.en: I also noticed that the first epoch was slower, but subsequent epochs went faster across both my local RTX 40 GPU and an A100 GPU on Google CoLab.
cues.zh: 也注意到，無論本機 RTX 40 GPU，或 Google Colab 的 A100，第一個訓練週期較慢，後續則比較快；本機完整型號的字幕不清。

cues.en: My speed speedups weren't as large as reported in the PyTorch 2.0 release notes.
cues.zh: 我的加速幅度沒有 PyTorch 2.0 發布說明那麼大。

cues.en: However, they were still around a 10% improvement on training epochs.
cues.zh: 不過，訓練週期仍大約改善 10%。

cues.en: I'm yet to explore mixed precision training or transformer like architectures, longer training runs, and this is where I think torch compile would probably be most effective.
cues.zh: 我還沒探索混合精度訓練、Transformer 類架構，以及更長的訓練；我認為 torch.compile 在這些情境可能最有效。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So what's happening behind the scenes?
cues.zh: 背後發生了什麼？

cues.en: Well, torch dot compile is designed to just work, but there are a few technologies backing it.
cues.zh: torch.compile 設計成拿來就能用，不過背後有幾項技術支撐。

cues.en: Torch Dynamo A autograd pre prim torch and torch inductor.
cues.zh: TorchDynamo、AOTAutograd、PrimTorch，以及 TorchInductor。

cues.en: The PyTorch 2.0 release notes explain these in more detail.
cues.zh: PyTorch 2.0 發布說明有更詳細的介紹。

cues.en: But from a high level, the two main improvements torch compile offers are number one fusion and number two graph capture.
cues.zh: 從高層次來看，torch.compile 提供兩項主要改善：第一，融合；第二，計算圖擷取。

cues.en: Fusion, also known as operator Fusion is one of the best ways to make deep learning models.
cues.zh: 融合，也稱運算子融合，是讓深度學習模型

cues.en: Go, Bert.
cues.zh: 高速運轉的好方法之一，快到發出「brrr」聲。

cues.en: Operator Fusion is just like fusion in Dragon Ball Z.
cues.zh: 運算子融合，就像七龍珠 Z 裡的融合。

cues.en: It condenses many operations into one or many to less.
cues.zh: 把許多操作濃縮成一個，或從多個減為更少個。

cues.en: Why modern GPUs have so much compute power that they are often not compute limited as in the main bottleneck
cues.zh: 為什麼？現代 GPU 的運算能力很強，往往不是受限於運算本身，也就是訓練模型的主要瓶頸，

cues.en: to training models is how fast can you get data from your CPU to your GPU?
cues.zh: 是你能多快把資料從 CPU 送到 GPU。

cues.en: This is known as bandwidth or memory bandwidth.
cues.zh: 這稱為頻寬，或記憶體頻寬。

cues.en: You want to reduce your bandwidth costs as much as possible and feed your data hungry GPUs with as much data as possible.
cues.zh: 你希望盡量降低頻寬成本，把越多資料餵給飢餓的 GPU 越好。

cues.en: So instead of performing an operation on a piece of data and then saving the result to memory computation,
cues.zh: 所以，不要對資料做一次操作就存回記憶體，反覆計算、

cues.en: memory computation in memory, you chain together as many operations as possible via fusion.
cues.zh: 存取記憶體、計算、再存取記憶體，而是透過融合，盡可能把多個操作串在一起。

cues.en: A rough analogy would be using a blender to make a smoothie.
cues.zh: 粗略的比喻，是用果汁機做果昔。

cues.en: Most blenders are good at blending things like GPUs are good at performing matrix multiplications.
cues.zh: 大多數果汁機擅長攪拌，就像 GPU 擅長矩陣乘法。

cues.en: Using a blender without operator fusion would be like adding each ingredient one by one and blending each time a new ingredient is added.
cues.zh: 不使用運算子融合，就像食材一個一個加，每加一個就攪拌一次。

cues.en: Not only is this insane, it increases your bandwidth costs.
cues.zh: 這不只很荒謬，也提高頻寬成本。

cues.en: The actual blending is fast each time for each single ingredient like computations generally are.
cues.zh: 每次對單一食材的實際攪拌都很快，就像運算通常很快，

cues.en: But you lose a bunch of time adding each ingredient one by one.
cues.zh: 但你花了很多時間逐一加入食材。

cues.en: Using a blender with operator Fusion is akin to using a blender by adding all the ingredients in at the start and then performing the blend.
cues.zh: 使用運算子融合，就像一開始把所有食材都加入，再進行一次攪拌。

cues.en: Once, of course, you lose a little time adding at the start, but you gain all of the lost memory bandwidth time back graph capture.
cues.zh: 當然，開頭加食材會花點時間，但能省回原本浪費的記憶體頻寬時間。接著是計算圖擷取。

cues.en: I'm less confident explaining, but the way I think about it is that graph capture or graph tracing is going through a series of operations that need to happen, such as the operations in a neural network
cues.zh: 這部分我比較沒把握解釋，但我的理解是，計算圖擷取或追蹤，會走過一系列需要執行的操作，例如神經網路中的操作，

cues.en: and capturing or tracing what needs to happen ahead of time.
cues.zh: 提前擷取或追蹤需要做的事。

cues.en: Computing without graph capture is like going to a new area and following directions.
cues.zh: 不使用計算圖擷取，就像開到陌生地區，依照導航，

cues.en: Turn by turn.
cues.zh: 一個轉彎、一個轉彎前進。

cues.en: As a good human driver, you can follow the turns quite easily, but you still have to think about each turn that you take.
cues.zh: 身為熟練駕駛，你很容易照著轉，但每次轉彎仍要思考。

cues.en: This is the equivalent to PyTorch having to look up what each operation does as it does it as in in order to perform an addition, it has to look up what an addition does before it can perform it.
cues.zh: 這就像 PyTorch 執行每個操作時，都要查它做什麼。例如要做加法，得先查加法如何執行，再去做。

cues.en: It does this quickly, but there's still non-zero overhead computing with graph capture is like driving through your own neighborhood.
cues.zh: 雖然很快，但額外負擔不為零。使用計算圖擷取，就像開車行經自己的社區。

cues.en: You barely think about what turns to make.
cues.zh: 幾乎不必思考該在哪裡轉彎。

cues.en: However, it took you some time up front to remember how to drive to your house.
cues.zh: 但你最初也花了一些時間，記住怎麼開回家。

cues.en: This is a caveat of graph capture.
cues.zh: 這就是計算圖擷取要注意的地方。

cues.en: It takes a little time up front to memorize the operations that need to happen, but subsequent computations should be faster.
cues.zh: 一開始要花點時間記住需要的操作，但後續運算應該會更快。

cues.zh: 想深入了解融合、

cues.zh: 記憶體頻寬與額外負擔，

cues.zh: 我推薦 Horace He 的 Making Deep Learning Go Brrr From First Principles。

cues.en: Outside of torch compile, there are plenty of other notable PyTorch 2.0 releases such as Faster Transformers is now in stable condition, which means that models that use the transformer style of architecture
cues.zh: 除了 torch.compile，PyTorch 2.0 還有許多值得注意的更新，例如 Faster Transformers 現在已穩定，代表使用 Transformer 類架構，

cues.en: or scaled dot product attention should be faster.
cues.zh: 或縮放點積注意力的模型，應該會更快。

cues.en: Universal device setup is now possible thanks to a context manager or global setting and a bunch of updated or metal performance shaders.
cues.zh: 透過環境管理器或全域設定，現在可以統一設定裝置；另外，也更新了許多 MPS，也就是 Metal Performance Shaders

cues.en: Operations improves Pytorch's coverage for Mac.
cues.zh: 操作，改善 PyTorch 對 Mac 的支援範圍。

cues.en: There's also a bunch of domain library upgrades to go along with PyTorch 2.0 in torch vision, torch text, torch rec, torch audio and more.
cues.zh: 還有許多領域函式庫配合 PyTorch 2.0 升級，包括 torchvision、torchtext、torchrec、torchaudio 等等。

cues.zh: 如果想了解 PyTorch 2.0 的所有更新，
